title: Quick Tip: Companial Brings the Heat to Directions EMEA 2025 – Are You In?
summary: Companial is presenting at Directions EMEA 2025 as a Platinum Sponsor, offering insights on migration programs, Cloud Hub, learning journeys, and discussions on AI agents, business central suitability, and report objects for dynamics 365 partners.
key_points: Companial is a Platinum Sponsor at Directions EMEA 2025 in Poznan and is promoting its migration programs, Cloud Hub and Learning Journeys
The post promises clarity on Microsoft changes to licensing, AI and partner incentives
Recommended sessions cover implementing agents, Sales Meets Business Central, AI storytelling, agentic AI and a deep dive on report objects and layouts
The post mentions a network of more than 1,000 Dynamics 365 partners
